Badge Printer Replacement - SOP (synthetic test document)

Owner: Jordan Example (Facilities). For questions about the badge printer ask Jordan Example, facilities-example@example.test.

When to use: the badge printer shows the red "Ribbon empty" light or prints blank badges.

Steps:
1. Power the printer off with the switch on the back.
2. Open the side cover and pull out the empty ribbon cartridge.
3. Slide in a new cartridge from the supply cabinet, shelf B, until it clicks.
4. Close the cover, power on and print one test badge.
5. If the test badge is blank, stop and contact Jordan Example; do not open the print head.

Decision: order a replacement printer instead of a ribbon when more than two ribbons fail in a month.
Cartridge supply is reordered by Facilities every first Monday.
